verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at rocm.docs.amd.com (HTTP 200). It covers the docs for the MI355X's ROCm software stack and notes that each sub-project has its own file, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Missing for 10: markdown renderings of doc pages (the .md probe returned 404), evidence of how complete or useful the llms.txt content is, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
